releaseNotes: Fix: the 5" reported zero touch events ever. Confirmed against the user's own board schematic (ESP32-8048S050C-I) that the touch controller's INT line isn't wired to GPIO18 at all -- that pin number came from a generic community board definition, not this specific board. LovyanGFX's GT911 driver gates every touch read on that pin's level when configured, so pointing it at an unrelated GPIO could permanently block touch detection. INT is now correctly left unused (-1); RST/SDA/SCL/I2C address were already correct and are unchanged.
